description: Source code for a custom Android spell checker service implementation, including a service class and an inner session class with methods for suggestion generation and sentence-level suggestions.

classes.name: SampleSpellCheckerService
classes.description: Main service class extending Android's SpellCheckerService, responsible for creating sessions.

classes.name: AndroidSpellCheckerSession
classes.description: Inner class extending SpellCheckerService.Session, implementing suggestion logic and sentence suggestions.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates and returns a new spell checker session.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the session, setting the locale.

methods.name: onGetSuggestions
methods.description: Provides spelling suggestions for a given TextInfo object.

methods.name: onGetSentenceSuggestionsMultiple
methods.description: Provides sentence-level suggestions for multiple TextInfo objects.

methods.name: isSentenceSpellCheckApiSupported
methods.description: Checks if sentence-level spell check API is supported based on Android version.
